{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Alamos Town |characters=アラモスタウン |japanese=Álamos Town |image=Alamos Town closer view.png |imagesize=300px |region=Sinnoh |epicode=M10 |episode=The Rise of Darkrai }} '''Alamos Town''' (Japanese: '''アラモスタウン''' ''Álamos Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in the [[Sinnoh]] [[region]] and the setting of ''[[M10|The Rise of Darkrai]]''. It is known for the works of architect [[Godey]], which include the [[Space-Time Towers]]. According to promotional maps, Alamos Town is located northwest of [[Oreburgh City]] and northeast of [[Jubilife City]], near the [[Ravaged Path]]. The main part of the town is on top of a large mesa in the middle of a lake. There is a bridge connecting the mesa to the mainland. The area around Alamos Town is heavily wooded with many hills and plateaus. Alamos Town is the [[hometown]] of [[Alice]], {{OBP|Tonio|M10}}, and [[Baron Alberto]]. Many {{p|Pidgey}} and {{p|Rattata}} can be seen roaming around town, and the local garden is home to a number of [[wild Pokémon]], including the {{pkmn2|Mythical}} {{OBP|Darkrai|M10}}. ==In animation== [[File:Alamos Town.png|thumb|250px|Alamos Town in another dimension]] {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} decided to visit Alamos Town because {{an|Dawn}} wanted to participate in the local [[Pokémon Contest]]. However, while on their way there they took the wrong road and ended up on a hill on the opposite side of town, away from the bridge that connects the mainland to the mesa where the town is located. Luckily for them, [[Alice]] offered them a ride on her hot-air balloon and later took them on a tour around town. After getting injured by {{mov|Dialga}}'s {{m|Roar of Time}} during a battle with it in the [[Unown Dimension]], {{mov|Palkia}} fled to Alamos Town to recover. It transported the town to a newly created [[dimension]], which prevented townspeople from leaving, and hid above the [[Space-Time Towers]]. Eventually, Dialga found Palkia's hiding and decided to continue their battle, which nearly destroyed the entire town despite {{OBP|Darkrai|M10}}'s efforts to stop them. It was revealed in ''[[M12|Arceus and the Jewel of Life]]'' that the two [[Legendary Pokémon]] were fighting due to distortions in both {{DL|Dimension|Dialga's world}} and {{DL|Dimension|Palkia's world}} caused by {{OBP|Arceus|M12}}'s imminent awakening. Darkrai tried multiple times to end the battle between Dialga and Palkia, but it was unsuccessful, and their rage only subsided when Ash and Dawn placed the [[Oración]] disk on the Space-Time Towers' music machine. After the song soothed them and healed Palkia's shattered pearl, Palkia returned Alamos Town to its proper dimension. Alamos Town appeared in the "World of Pokémon" intro in ''[[M11|Giratina and the Sky Warrior]]'', as well as in a flashback in which [[Newton Graceland]] observed the battle between Dialga and Palkia through a portal in the [[Reverse World]]. It then made two brief reappearances in ''Arceus and the Jewel of Life''. After observing disruptions in the [[Time-Space Axis]], [[Sheena]] and {{OBP|Kevin|M12}} traveled to Alamos Town and were present at its plateau when Palkia returned the town to its proper dimension. Later on, during the ending credits, a brief update on Alice, {{OBP|Tonio|M10}}, [[Baron Alberto]], and Darkrai is shown. Alamos Town also appeared in ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]'', which is set in a timeline different from the main series. ==Places of interest== ===Contest Hall=== [[File:Alamos Town Contest Hall interior.png|thumb|250px|Inside the Alamos Town Contest Hall]] {{main|Contest Hall}} Located within the Space-Time Towers, the Alamos Town Contest Hall is unlike many modern {{cat|buildings}} that host [[Pokémon Contest]]s in that it has several rows of seats at stage level in addition to a sloped seating area. It was visited by {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} while [[Alice]] was guiding them around town. Sporting a dress different from the one she normally wears when competing, as well as white boots and a pink-colored headpiece, {{an|Dawn}} entered the Alamos Contest along with fellow [[Pokémon Coordinator]]s [[Allegra]], {{OBP|Kai|M10}}, and [[Maury]]. She managed to clear the [[Appeal|Performance Stage]], but ended up losing a match where her {{TP|Dawn|Piplup}} faced off against Allegra's {{p|Infernape}} in the [[Contest Battle|Battle Stage]]. It is unknown if she lost at the semifinal or final round, but she and Kai are shown behind Allegra when she is lifting the Alamos [[Ribbon]] in celebration of her victory. ===Godey's Garden=== Godey's Garden, named after its architect [[Godey]], is a park inhabited by many [[wild Pokémon]] and [[Alice]]'s favorite part of town. According to {{an|Brock}}'s travel guide, the park was designed with a theme of nature, [[Human|people]], and {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} living in harmony. This is reflected in the abundance of greenery and water fountains. It is the place where [[Alicia]] first met {{OBP|Darkrai|M10}}, after finding it resting underneath a tree after it was attacked by a {{p|Roserade}}, a {{p|Kirlia}}, and a {{p|Luxray}} that were feeling threatened due to its presence. After helping the {{pkmn|category|Pitch-Black Pokémon}} recover from its injuries and telling it that the park was meant for everyone, Darkrai decided to live there. It has a play area for Pokémon complete with a {{wp|playground slide}}, a {{wp|seesaw}}, and {{wp|Swing (seat)|swings}}. ===Pokémon Center=== {{main|Pokémon Center}} Many {{pkmn|Trainer}}s took their {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} to the Alamos Town Pokémon Center after {{OBP|Darkrai|M10}} put them to {{status|sleep}} by using {{m|Dark Void}} to defend itself from their attacks. ===Space-Time Towers=== {{main|Space-Time Towers}} The town's centerpiece is the [[Space-Time Towers]], which were designed by [[Godey]] one hundred years ago. The tower on the right symbolizes time and has angular sculptures that correspond to {{p|Dialga}}'s diamond, while the tower on the left symbolizes space and has rounded sculptures that correspond to {{p|Palkia}}'s pearls. The Alamos Town [[Contest Hall]] is located in its interior, while outside in between the towers there is a music room equipped with a unique music device where special disks can be placed to allow a song to be played. This makes the towers the {{pkmn|world}}'s largest musical instrument. ==Gallery== {| class="roundy" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemedark|DP}}; border: 3px solid #{{sinnoh color}}" |- style="background:#{{colorschemelight|DP}}" ! style="{{roundytl|5px}}" | {{color2|000|Space-Time Towers}} ! {{color2|000|Contest Hall}} ! Godey's Garden ! style="{{roundytr|5px}}" | {{color2|000|Pokémon Center}} |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Space-Time Towers birds-eye view.png|x160px]] | [[File:Alamos Town Contest Hall.png|x160px]] | [[File:Godey Garden.png|x160px]] | [[File:Alamos Pokémon Center.png|x160px]] |} ==Trivia== [[File:Alamos Town Establishing shot.png|300px|thumb|The cliffs surrounding Alamos Town]] * The only {{p|Shellos}} that appears in the movie is of the East Sea {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Shellos and Gastrodon|variety}}, although Alamos Town is actually on the ''west'' side of [[Mt. Coronet]]. * The [[Alamos Darkrai|Darkrai]] distributed in the United States, as well as the ones distributed in the European countries, had the [[Original Trainer|OT]] "ALAMOS", a reference to the tenth movie {{OBP|Darkrai|M10}}'s appearance in Alamos Town. ===Origin=== {{main|Pokémon world in relation to the real world#In the movies|Pokémon world in relation to the real world → In the movies}} Alamos Town is modeled after the municipality of {{wp|Ronda}} in {{wp|Andalusia}} and the city of {{wp|Barcelona}} in {{wp|Catalonia}}, where both are located in {{wp|Spain}}Third Installment of the Interview with Director [[Kunihiko Yuyama|Yuyama]]! Behind-the-Scenes Stories from the Director's Production!? on the Pokémon movie official blog ([https://web.archive.org/web/20070212075759/http://blog.pokemon-movie.jp/2007/2007/02/post_27.html archived]) (Japanese). The cityscape corresponds to the mountaintop city of Ronda with the city divided by the canyon of El Tajo. The bridges of Puente Romano, {{wp|Puente Viejo}}, and {{wp|Puente Nuevo}} span through El Tajo to connect the two parts of the city. The architecture of various areas is inspired by {{wp|Modernisme|Catalan modernism}} with the [[Space-Time Towers]] and Godey's Garden being based on {{wp|Sagrada Família}} and {{wp|Park Güell}} in Barcelona. Both the basilica and the park were designed by Catalan architect {{wp|Antoni Gaudí}}, paralleled by the towers and the garden in Alamos Town being designed by [[Godey]] and his descendant {{OBP|Tonio|M10}}. The mountains in the background landscape may be inspired by the mountain range of {{wp|Montserrat (mountain)|Montserrat}} located near Barcelona. {{wp|Flamenco}} dancing is also featured in the film where the dance style originates from Andalusia in Spain. ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{colorschemedark|DP}}; border:3px solid #{{sinnoh color}}" |- ! style="background:#{{colorschemelight|DP}}" | Language ! style="background:#{{colorschemelight|DP}}" | Name ! style="background:#{{colorschemelight|DP}}" | Origin |- | Japanese | アラモスタウン ''Álamos Town'' | rowspan="6" | From ''álamos'' (Spanish for "{{wp|Populus|poplar}}s") |- | English, German, Danish, Finnish,
